summary: AI finance team for freelancers: finds money leaks in Zetaris data, explains why with evidence, simulates what-ifs, and ranks moves the user approves or rejects.

data.access: Agents read data only through Zetaris views via POST /sql-editor/sqls/run (SELECT only)

power.ai_provider: Meterless Nightshift (Meterless Runtime 1.4, provider contract v4)

meterless_engines.role: Shared state for agents: clients, vendors, invoices and findings ingested from Zetaris views; getContext(entityId) for agents
Remembers each approve/reject decision; top memories are retrieved at run start and change the CFO ranking
Runs the Explainer investigation in bounded chunks, one hypothesis per chunk, carrying evidence forward

traces: logs/<run_id>.jsonl, one line per agent step
